capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Polestar US spec page: 82 kWh capacity (gross/usable not split) at 400 V.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (European MY24 Polestar 2, same 82 kWh pack): 79.0 kWh usable. Wikipedia: 79 usable / 82 gross for single 2024-25 and dual 2025.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: NMC for all Polestar 2 packs (EV Database also NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Polestar US spec page: 400 V lithium-ion, 82 kWh.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Same line as the 2024 manual: the 2024 and 2023 US Polestar 2 manuals describe only the Google Maps navigation trigger (no manual control); the 2021 manual only says preconditioning lengthens charging time. Nothing shows a change for this model year.

dc_max_kw.notes: Polestar US spec page (Dual motor with Performance pack, 82 kWh): up to 205 kW DC, 10-80% in 28 min. Wikipedia: single 205 kW from 2024, dual 205 kW from 2025. OpenEV shows 78/75/150 for these cars, which is stale.

ac_max_kw.notes: Polestar US spec page: AC 11 kW (three-phase 16 A line); North American cars charge single-phase 48 A = 11 kW per the 2023 US manual.

published_10_80_min.notes: Polestar US spec page: 10-80% in 28 min.
